commands.topic: The machine's heartbeat 🛰️ 4 live scan events daily — 9a / 1p / 5p / 9p ET. Countdown → collection → analysis → picks.

commands.content:
🛰️ **WELCOME TO THE SCAN FEED**

This is where the machine breathes. **4 live scan events every day** (all times ET):

🕘 **9:00 AM** — morning card build
🕐 **1:00 PM** — afternoon window
🕔 **5:00 PM** — primetime prep (the big one)
🕘 **9:00 PM** — late slate + overnight esports

**How every scan runs:**
⏳ Countdown right here, 60 and 10 minutes out
📡 Collection — odds across the market, 🚑 injury reports, confirmed lineups, roster moves
🧠 Analysis — hundreds of thousands of parameters crunched live
✅ Finale — what dropped in each tier room, the 🎯 free pick, and the 🚫 passes (games we turned down, and why)

Every pick in your tier room now carries **📋 roster/injury intel** — including **🚨 LATE flags** when a scratch breaks news-side. Between scans, only 🚨 FLASH plays fire — and only when the edge can't wait.

Next scan is always on the clock above. 🤖
